I currently teach Python programming to undergraduates as a graduate teaching assistant.

work.position: ECE Graduate Teaching Assistant — Intro to Programming in Python
work.summary: Guiding over 100 students across two semesters through Python programming labs, reinforcing data types, control flow, functions, classes, and object-oriented programming.
highlights: Guided over 100 students across two semesters (40 in Fall 2025; 60 in Spring 2026) through Python programming labs, reinforcing data types, control flow, functions, classes, and object-oriented programming

Coached student teams through the course's capstone project — a visual/interactive Python application (2D game, GUI, or data visualization) — with emphasis on effectively directing AI coding assistants while still being able to explain, modify, and defend every line of code

Developed and delivered interactive coding demos to strengthen conceptual understanding and problem-solving skills; assessed each student's working code and explanations at biweekly capstone-project lab checkpoints as well as final presentations, requiring demonstrated understanding for full credit

work.summary: Built and deployed a low-code data platform for UH Mānoa School of Nursing and UHP staff, working directly with non-technical clinical stakeholders.
highlights: Built and deployed a low-code AppSheet data platform for UH Mānoa School of Nursing and UHP staff, working directly with non-technical clinical stakeholders to define requirements and automate partitioning, sorting, and presentation of EPIC request status data

Wrote Python scripts to extend an ETL pipeline integrating Freshworks with HelloSign for end-to-end automated tracking of the EPIC request form lifecycle, and automated twice-daily data ingestion into Google Sheets dashboards, improving data reliability and reducing manual status checks

awards.title: International SeaPerch Challenge High School Stock Class 3rd Place
awards.summary: SeaPerch is an underwater ROV competition and community with over 250,000 student participants. The team that I led placed 3rd out of 57 in our class at international competition.
